summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long PENG Daily Target ETF (PENU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Penguin Solutions Incorporation stock (NASDAQ: PENG), less fees, and expenses. PENG engages in designing, building, and managing enterprise solutions. PENU was launched on Aug 6, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
